<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="16" y="21" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">9:41</text>
    <line x1="317" y1="20" x2="317" y2="15" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="322" y1="20" x2="322" y2="12" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="327" y1="20" x2="327" y2="9" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="16" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="339" y1="13" x2="345" y2="19" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="355" y="10" width="19" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="375" y="14" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#111111"/>
    <rect x="358" y="13" width="13" height="6" rx="1" fill="#111111"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Top app bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="64" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="16" y1="95" x2="374" y2="95" stroke="#CDCDCD" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="20" y="72" font-family="Open Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="400" fill="#111111">amazon</text>
    <line x1="321" y1="58" x2="341" y2="58" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="321" y1="64" x2="341" y2="64" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="321" y1="70" x2="341" y2="70" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="349" y="49" width="32" height="40" rx="5" fill="#D9E7CB"/>
      <polyline points="354,56 358,56 360,72 374,72 377,61 359,61" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="362" cy="78" r="2" fill="#111111"/>
      <circle cx="373" cy="78" r="2" fill="#111111"/>
      <circle cx="375" cy="54" r="6" fill="#111111"/>
      <text x="375" y="57" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">0</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Page heading -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="139" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">Your Shopping Cart</text>
    <line x1="16" y1="155" x2="374" y2="155" stroke="#CDCDCD" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Empty cart illustration -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="245" r="79" fill="#D9E7CB"/>
    <rect x="142" y="213" width="106" height="72" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="130,197 143,197 150,250 236,250 248,211 144,211" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="165" cy="270" r="7" fill="#111111"/>
    <circle cx="222" cy="270" r="7" fill="#111111"/>
    <line x1="160" y1="228" x2="231" y2="228" stroke="#CDCDCD" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="160" y1="240" x2="220" y2="240" stroke="#CDCDCD" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="195,219 198,226 206,226 200,231 202,239 195,234 188,239 190,231 184,226 192,226" fill="#D9E7CB" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="253" cy="190" r="13" fill="#111111"/>
    <polyline points="247,190 251,194 259,185" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Empty state copy -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">Your cart is empty</text>
    <text x="195" y="379" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Sign in to see the items you've added</text>
    <text x="195" y="400" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">or start shopping to find something you love.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Account actions -->
  <g>
    <rect x="70" y="427" width="250" height="46" rx="100" fill="#111111"/>
    <text x="195" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign in</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="70" y="485" width="250" height="46" rx="100" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="514" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">Create your Amazon account</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Separator and shopping action -->
  <line x1="32" y1="566" x2="358" y2="566" stroke="#CDCDCD" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="70" y="587" width="250" height="46" rx="100" fill="#D9E7CB"/>
    <text x="195" y="616" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">Continue shopping</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="760" width="390" height="84" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="760" x2="390" y2="760" stroke="#CDCDCD" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,781 49,773 59,781 59,794 39,794" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polygon points="36,782 49,771 62,782" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="49" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#111111">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Categories -->
    <g>
      <line x1="112" y1="773" x2="132" y2="773" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="112" y1="780" x2="132" y2="780" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="112" y1="787" x2="132" y2="787" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="122" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#111111">Categories</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Orders -->
    <g>
      <rect x="187" y="774" width="20" height="17" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="191" y1="779" x2="203" y2="779" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="191" y1="784" x2="200" y2="784" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="197" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#111111">Orders</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Cart selected -->
    <g>
      <rect x="261" y="770" width="54" height="48" rx="24" fill="#D9E7CB"/>
      <polyline points="274,780 278,780 281,792 304,792 308,783 279,783" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <circle cx="285" cy="798" r="2.5" fill="#111111"/>
      <circle cx="302" cy="798" r="2.5" fill="#111111"/>
      <text x="288" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#111111">Cart</text>
      <circle cx="307" cy="777" r="7" fill="#111111"/>
      <text x="307" y="780" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">0</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Account -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="355" cy="778" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="355" cy="792" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="355" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#111111">Account</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
